orientation: PR-3 implements currency exchange support (EUR, SEK, USD) by introducing IFxService and FxService with EUR triangulation and half-away-from-zero rounding. It extends the Payment entity with CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, and Rate, and updates PaymentService to support cross-currency transfers routed through FxClearing ledger accounts while converting amounts to EUR for daily transfer limit checks.

findings.title: Missing test coverage for PaymentService cross-currency flows and EUR daily limits
findings.claim: The acceptance criteria explicitly require automated xUnit tests covering cross-currency PaymentService flows (verifying FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, Rate) and EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement. However, FxTests only tests FxService in isolation and directly invokes ILedger without exercising PaymentService.PayAsync or daily transfer limit calculations.
findings.requirement_link: Automated xUnit tests cover FxService (same currency returning 1, EUR/SEK/USD direct and inverse pairs, SEK<->USD triangulation, half-away-from-zero rounding to 2 decimals, ArgumentException on unknown currency), cross-currency PaymentService flows (including FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, Rate), and EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Add test methods to Bank.Tests that instantiate PaymentService and call PayAsync across currencies to verify: (1) payer debited to FxClearing, (2) payee credited from FxClearing, (3) Payment entity properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, and Rate, and (4) rejection when daily payments exceed DailyTransferLimit in EUR equivalent.

findings.title: No test coverage for EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement in PaymentService
findings.claim: PaymentService now converts historical same-day payments and the incoming payment request to EUR to validate against DailyTransferLimit. However, no automated tests exist to verify that cross-currency and multi-currency daily payment totals are correctly converted and that DailyLimitExceededException is thrown when the limit is breached.
findings.requirement_link: Automated xUnit tests cover FxService (same currency returning 1, EUR/SEK/USD direct and inverse pairs, SEK<->USD triangulation, half-away-from-zero rounding to 2 decimals, ArgumentException on unknown currency), cross-currency PaymentService flows (including FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, Rate), and EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests for PaymentService.PayAsync that record completed payments in non-EUR currencies and assert that attempting an additional payment that exceeds DailyTransferLimit in EUR equivalent throws DailyLimitExceededException.
findings.drop_reason: Capped at Major: a tests finding is never Critical on its own

findings.title: PaymentService cross-currency payment execution and Payment properties are not tested
findings.claim: Acceptance criterion 12 requires automated test coverage for cross-currency PaymentService flows including FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties. The test in FxTests calls ILedger.PostTransferAsync directly instead of calling PaymentService.PayAsync, leaving PaymentService's dual-leg ledger orchestration, cross-currency validations, and Payment entity field mapping completely unexercised.
findings.requirement_link: Automated xUnit tests cover FxService (same currency returning 1, EUR/SEK/USD direct and inverse pairs, SEK<->USD triangulation, half-away-from-zero rounding to 2 decimals, ArgumentException on unknown currency), cross-currency PaymentService flows (including FxClearing ledger transfers and Payment properties CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, Rate), and EUR-equivalent daily transfer limit enforcement.
findings.suggested_fix: Add unit tests invoking PaymentService.PayAsync across different currencies (e.g. EUR to SEK, SEK to USD) that verify both ledger legs through BankAccounts.For(BankAccountKind.FxClearing, currency) and assert that CreditedAmount, CreditedCurrency, and Rate are correctly assigned and persisted.
